The search returned empty list. Maybe need also specify bonds broken/formed. The forward reaction breaks C-O bond and forms C-X bond. So bonds_broken: ["C-O"]? The format expects strings like "6-8"? Not sure. Could try without target molecule? Maybe target is different. Perhaps the target molecule is the product of substitution: an alkyl halide derived from an alcohol. The precursors list includes "CC(C)(C)C(=O)Cl" and "Cc1ccc(Br)cc1". That seems unrelated to substitution of OH with halogen. Maybe the target molecule is "CC(C)(C)C(=O)Oc1ccc(Br)cc1" (ester). The forward reaction would be ester formation (acyl chloride + phenol). The broken group: "aliphatic hydroxyls"? Actually phenol is aromatic hydroxyl. So functional_groups_broken: ["aromatic hydroxyls"], functional_groups_formed: ["acyl chloride"? Not. The forward forms ester (carboxylic ester). So functional_groups_formed: ["carboxylic esters"].

Let's try search with target SMILES "CC(C)(C)C(=O)Oc1ccc(Br)cc1". Use broken aromatic hydroxyl, formed carboxylic ester.
